lines: Oh.. um.. hello, and goodbye, I think.
I'll mark your page, so you can find your place again.
Please don't be scared, it's only the end of the chapter.
I didn't mean to look up right then.. sorry.
aki.loreLine: Sorry about earlier.. and about this.

lines: Welcome, welcome.. and do mind the exit on your way out.
Applause, please, for a lovely little run.
Take a bow, guest, you've earned it.
Gently now, darling.. there we are.
briselle.loreLine: I'll count to ten, darling, I always count to ten.

lines: By definition you're an intruder, and I didn't say a nice definition.
I don't think, I read, and you read as caught.
Your light didn't match the locker, I did notice.
One more for the count, and I'll say it out loud.

loreLine.text: Her lens whirs, and she writes something down.

lines: Nothing personal, I just patrol, and you were in it.
Steady, sensible, and right behind you.
Deal's done, cut the deck and try again.
Don't worry, it's the boring ending.
dovelle.loreLine: Good game, guest.. nobody's winning tonight.

lines: You ran so much I couldn't lose you.
Rematch any time, I'll be faster.
Fastest catch on the floor, somebody write it down!
elise.loreLine: That wasn't a race at all, was it..

lines: Eek.. oh no, I caught you, I'm so sorry!
I didn't scream this time, did you notice?
Please don't look at me, I'm very bad at being looked at.
You hid so well I almost walked right past you.
ferryn.loreLine: Sorry, sorry, I'm sorry.. hi, and bye.

lines: Hm hm hmm.. oh, you're still here?
The music stopped, and so did you.
Wind it next time, I get cranky without my song.
Shh, this is my favourite bit.
glyra.loreLine: You stopped listening before the good part.

lines: Fetched you, can I keep the relay too?
I heard you pull it from three halls away.
Good catch, right, did I do good?
Your relay smelled like you, so I followed.
haelith.loreLine: Found you, and I was gentle, wasn't I?

lines: I was here the whole time, obviously.
Don't look so surprised, it's my corner.
Mm, you stopped watching, so I stopped waiting.
I wasn't chasing you, I was just already there.
ilyra.loreLine: I could see you better from up here.

lines: Told you, nobody ever listens when I say it.
Eight seconds outside your locker is plenty, thank you.
Up, out, done, no arguing.
Hiding is fine until somebody waits outside.
javelle.loreLine: Come out, I know you're in there.. oh, you did.

lines: Ugh, fine, you're caught, happy now?
That locker was rubbish anyway, you're welcome.
Don't look at me like that, I'm being helpful.
You hid under my stuff, which is rude.
loxelle.loreLine: Oh, great, was it something I said?

lines: Guest stepped on scanner; guest departed; noted.
Protocol was followed, by me, at least.
Incident logged, cause: you.
mavrine.loreLine: For the record, I have three times for this and none agree.

lines: Question: why would anyone let the light die?
The dim parts are mine, and you wandered in.
Dim, quiet, and all mine.. thanks for the invite.
Shh, I'm not rude like the light.
nyxie.loreLine: Oh, good, you turned it off.

lines: Should I tell everyone, I'm telling everyone!
You were by my relay, so I announced you.
Found you, found you, FOUND YOU!
You were so loud that everybody heard.
opalie.loreLine: Everyone, I caught one, now it's official!

lines: I was right beside you, nobody ever looks.
Shh.. I'll close the door behind you.
You looked straight through me, it happens.
Softly now, it's over.
porcelle.loreLine: It's all right, most people don't see me the first time.

lines: Your light was on too long, so I locked on.
Don't flatter yourself, I was going this way.
Stay still, I'm warming up to you.
Wrong turn, guest, I was always on yours.
quenelle.loreLine: Got you, and I'm not letting go.

lines: Surprise, that tile was mine!
You found the real door eventually.. it was me.
Didn't see that one coming, did you?
That door was fake, and I'm very proud of it.
ravelle.loreLine: Exits are just traps that let you go, guest.

lines: Too hot to run, and I'm still warming up!
Did you think the heat was just weather?
Ugh, don't thank me, just get out of my hall.
Told you it was getting warm in here!
solyth.loreLine: You're in my hall.. well, you were.

lines: Correction: that footstep was me, not her.
Wrong hunter, right voice, and I audit everything.
You followed the sound, sloppy but understandable.
Your echo was mine the whole time.
thessine.loreLine: Say something, I'll tell you if it sounds like you.

lines: Sorry, habit, I looked like a friend.
Which runner was me, did you check the nametag?
I borrowed your walk, I'll give it back.
You trusted the nametag, and that's on me, sorry.
umbriel.loreLine: Sorry.. I just wanted to feel like I knew what to do.

lines: You came into the vents, and that's my house.
Told you, nothing in here but dust and me.
You can go now, I'm bored.
You should've watched the walls, I live in them.
verrine.loreLine: Guests always think the back is safe.

lines: It was nearer than where you left it.
Watched, it waits; unwatched, it arrives.
It never ran, and you never saw it move.
voidblack.loreLine: You looked away for one second.

lines: Your beam missed it by a step.
Invisible was never the same as absent.
It was waiting for the flash.
voidblue.loreLine: Even the hunters say they didn't see it there.

lines: The locker was sealed before you reached it.
No hiding spot near it stays a hiding spot.
Every door you tried was already shut.
voidbrown.loreLine: It stands where it wasn't yesterday, facing the hall.

lines: It held its sightline, and the others came.
It saw you long enough to share.
Every hunter knew where you were.
Two and a half seconds was plenty.
You stood still too long.
The grace ran out before you moved.
It found you standing still.
voidgray.loreLine: Gray: stairwell four, then wherever you stood still.

lines: It came out of the vent nine steps closer.
The grille rattled once, and then it was here.
The vents connect, and so did it.
voidgreen.loreLine: Something in the vents kept going, exactly as fast as before.

lines: The flashlight died at the worst possible second.
Radar down, climate down, you down.
Nine seconds without a light is a long time.
voidorange.loreLine: Nobody asked it to stand there, and nobody asks it to leave.

lines: Those footsteps were never real, but this is.
The breathing came from the wrong side.
The radar lied, politely.
voidpink.loreLine: You spoke to it; none of them ever answers.

lines: The radar showed nothing where it stood.
Static, then black, then nothing on the radar.
You read the noise as quiet.
Eleven seconds blind was enough.
The hall was long, and it was faster.
It was faster in the corridor than you.
Rooms slow it and halls don't, and you chose the hall.
voidred.loreLine: Up and down the straight hall, never stopping, then you.

lines: It stood frozen in the beam, then the beam moved.
The beam slipped off it for one moment.
It moved the moment the light did.
Your beam was somewhere else.
It grew faster while the map was open.
You read the map one second too long.
Every glance at the map made it faster.
The map stayed open, and it kept coming.
You let it get cold, so I got here.
Shh.. warm up somewhere else.
I'd say sorry, but it would come out cold.
wynelle.loreLine: Someone has to, and I'm already cold.

lines: WHEE, did you see that, I cut the corner!
Faster, faster.. oh, that's you, hi!
Officially, that's a catch!
Again, again, let's go again!
xivvy.loreLine: Two seconds, one and a half, caught you!

lines: Your battery's mine now, I'll look after it.
Sit still, I just want to remember this.
Everyone drops something, so I'll keep yours.
ysolde.loreLine: You ran, so I'll put that on your tag.

lines: Every deal has a price, and you just paid it.
No refunds, sorry, house rules.
Bad luck, guest, that was the expensive one.
Don't tell anyone, but the tea was free.
zellia.loreLine: The first one's always free, guest; this wasn't the first.

nyxie.text: The light gave out before you did.

darkness.text: Dark halls keep whatever wanders into them.

deal.text: Some deals cost more than coins.
The trade went through, and so did you.

cold.text: The cold got there before the heater did.
Too cold to run, too late to warm up.

fallback: A hunter intercepted your signal on depth {depth}.
